questions.question: In CS2023's requirements curriculum, which functional-requirement description approaches are named, and is one ranked best?
questions.criteria: Mentions use cases and user stories; describes method's design/implementation support plus strengths/weaknesses; notes no superiority ranking
questions.traps: Claims required universal method or empirically proven superiority

questions.question: Does CS2023 distinguish architectural from detailed design, and specify exact criteria for their boundary?
questions.criteria: Two levels of design abstraction are distinguished; detailed boundary criteria not supplied by the cited curriculum item
questions.traps: Implies ISO 42010 was directly inspected or gives a universal boundary

questions.question: How does the CS2023 SE-Validation unit distinguish verification from validation?
questions.criteria: Verification asks whether building right; validation asks whether the right thing is built; explicitly curriculum-scoped
questions.traps: Asserts professional-standard authority from an uninspected ISO source

questions.question: Does SWEBOK v4.0a's construction definition include verification, tests and debugging, and establish fixed process boundaries?
questions.criteria: Construction includes coding, verification, unit/integration testing and debugging; design also occurs there; boundaries vary with lifecycle

questions.question: Does CS2023's Software Reliability unit specify a measurement procedure for its reliability quantities?
questions.criteria: Mentions probability-of-failure / mean-time-between-failures characterizations; faults cause failures; no measurement procedure in this extracted topic
questions.traps: Invents a reliability formula or calls the curriculum a normative standard

questions.question: Is maintenance in SWEBOK v4.0a limited to post-delivery, and was the cited ISO 14764 text inspected here?
questions.criteria: Activities occur pre-/post-delivery; cost-effective support for operational software; ISO 14764 objective is reported second-hand by SWEBOK
questions.traps: Treats project as having inspected ISO 14764 normative text

questions.question: What activities fall under software engineering management according to SWEBOK v4.0a, and does that establish universal consensus?
questions.criteria: Planning, estimating, measuring, controlling, coordinating, leading and risk management, stakeholder outcome; explicitly SWEBOK definition
questions.traps: Claims industry-wide consensus/regulation not established by corpus
